**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** 2024-2026 CFP 顯示徵稿方向聚焦「精神分析與心理學交會處引發的議題」——即用心理學研究方法檢驗/擴充精神分析理論,或將精神分析概念應用於心理現象與人格發展研究。

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** clinical papers/case studies, quantitative empirical research, qualitative empirical research, mixed-methods research, literature reviews, original theoretical/conceptual papers, replication studies (含未成功複製), clinical notes, brief reports, commentary, book reviews
